latest_release.body:
Note that `neovide_fill_bottom_background` is [opt-in](https://neovide.dev/configuration.html#bottom-background-fill-available-since-0172) by default from now since it is an experimental option.

## What's Changed
* feat: add bottom background filling toggle by @falcucci in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3626
* fix: address CVE-2026-25541 by @falcucci in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3622
* fix: address GHSA-3PV8-6F4R-FFG2 by @falcucci in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3623
* fix: address GHSA-CQ8V-F236-94QC by @falcucci in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3625
* fix: constrain bottom background filling to the main grid by @falcucci in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3629
* fix: support macOS proxy icon state on neovim nightly (0.13+) by @falcucci in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3630
* fix: turn bottom background filling opt-in by default by @falcucci in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3631


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/neovide/neovide/compare/0.17.1...0.17.2
